rules.why: Rewrites export style between named and default; breaks framework routers (Next.js, Remix, Astro) and Knip dynamic entry tracking.

Prefixes promises with void; silences unhandled asynchronous errors instead of awaiting them.
Converts let to const; variables reassigned across async callbacks or closures can throw "Assignment to constant variable". Allowed only when the scope is provably local.
